Key Lime Pie Colada

.cook
#rum
👥 1 servings 🍽️ Cocktails ⏱️ Prep Time: 1 minute 🔥 Cook Time: 1 minute 📖 www.reddit.com

🥘 Ingredients

  • Appleton Signature
    1/2 oz
  • Bittermens Elemakule tiki bitters
    8 drops
  • El Dorado 8
    1/2 oz
  • Graham Cracker Syrup*
    1 oz
  • Ice
  • Key Lime Pie Mix*
    1 oz
  • Key lime juice
    3/4 oz
  • Mint
  • Orchid
  • Pineapple juice
    1 oz
  • Planteray 3 Stars
    1 1/2 oz
  • Saline solution (20%)
    8 drops

🍳 Cookware

  • Pilsner glass

Instructions

  1. 1
    Combine all ingredients in a blender with 6 oz of pebble Ice : Planteray 3 Stars (or white rum), El Dorado 8 (or aged rum), Appleton Signature (or Jamaican rum), Key lime juice , Pineapple juice , Graham Cracker Syrup* , Key Lime Pie Mix* , Bittermens Elemakule tiki bitters , Saline solution (20%) .
    Ice, Planteray 3 Stars: 1 1/2 oz, El Dorado 8: 1/2 oz, Appleton Signature: 1/2 oz, Key lime juice: 3/4 oz, Pineapple juice: 1 oz, Graham Cracker Syrup*: 1 oz, Key Lime Pie Mix*: 1 oz, Bittermens Elemakule tiki bitters: 8 drops, Saline solution (20%): 8 drops
  2. 2
    Briefly flash blend until just incorporated and chilled.
  3. 3
    Open pour into a Pilsner glass .
  4. 4
    Top off with additional pebble Ice to fill the glass.
    Ice
  5. 5
    Garnish with a Mint bouquet and an Orchid .
    Mint, Orchid
  6. 📝

    Graham Cracker Syrup: Gently crush 9 full graham cracker sheets (36 individual rectangles, roughly 135 grams) and toast in a pan over medium-low heat for 5 minutes until browning starts and they become fragrant. Remove from heat and add to 12 oz water. Allow to infuse for 45 minutes before passing through a fine sieve lined with cheesecloth to remove solids. Weigh out weight of graham cracker water in grams, then combine in a saucepan with an equal weight of cane sugar, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, a pinch of ground cinnamon, and a pinch of salt. Heat on low just until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat, allow to cool and bottle. Keep refrigerated and shake before using.

  7. 📝

    Key Lime Pie Mix: Combine 6 oz sweetened condensed milk, 6 oz coconut milk, and 3 teaspoons freshly grated key lime zest. Whisk vigorously to combine, then store in refrigerator for 4 hours. Pour through a fine sieve to remove zest and bottle. Keep refrigerated and shake before using.
